raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: This line chart, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the evolution of the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers in a model, comparing three distinct conditions. The horizontal axis, labeled "Layer," represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 25 with numerical tick marks at intervals of 5. The vertical axis, labeled "Abs Mean," represents the absolute mean value, ranging from 0 to 4 with tick marks at intervals of 1. The chart displays three data series: a dashed blue line representing the "hidden state mean before gate," which starts at a value of approximately 0.1 and remains relatively stable until layer 20, after which it sharply increases to a value of approximately 4.3; a dotted orange line for the "hidden state mean after gate," which begins at a value of approximately 0.01 and remains nearly flat, staying below 0.05 across all layers; and a solid green line for the "hidden state mean of baseline," which starts at a value of approximately 0.01 and remains nearly flat, staying below 0.05 across all layers.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: The figure, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers for three distinct cases: the hidden state mean before a gate, the hidden state mean after a gate, and the hidden state mean of a baseline. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to 23 in integer steps, representing the layer number in a neural network. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," ranges from 0 to 4, indicating the absolute mean value. The blue dashed line, representing the "hidden state mean before gate," starts at a value of approximately 0.1 at layer 0, fluctuates slightly between 0.2 and 0.4 for layers 1 to 20, and then sharply increases to a value of approximately 4.3 at layer 23. The orange dotted line, representing the "hidden state mean after gate," remains nearly constant at a value of approximately 0.05 across all layers. The green solid line, representing the "hidden state mean of baseline," starts at a value of approximately 0.01 at layer 0 and gradually increases to a value of approximately 0.1 at layer 23.
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: The plot illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers, comparing three conditions: the hidden state mean before a gate, the hidden state mean after a gate, and the hidden state mean of a baseline. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 25 with tick marks at intervals of 5, and the y-axis represents the absolute mean, ranging from 0 to 4. The blue dashed line, labeled "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," starts at approximately 0.2 at layer 0, fluctuates slightly between 0.2 and 0.6 across layers 0 to 20, and then sharply increases to about 4.3 at layer 25. The orange dotted line, labeled "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," remains nearly flat and close to 0 across all layers, with values ranging from approximately 0.02 to 0.04. The green solid line, labeled "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04," also remains nearly flat, starting at approximately 0.02 and increasing slightly to about 0.15 by layer 25.
